preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(input[i] == output[i] for i in range(len(input)) if input[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: All spaces in the input string are retained in their original positions in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == input[j] for i, j in enumerate(reversed(range(len(input)))) if input[j] != ' ' and (i == 0 or output[i-1] == ' '))
postconditions.description: Each word in the input string is reversed in the output, where a word is defined as a maximal sequence of non-space characters.
